# Source and local adaptations

Source: [obra/superpowers, `skills/verification-before-completion/SKILL.md`](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/blob/2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b/skills/verification-before-completion/SKILL.md).
Pinned release: `v7.0.1`, commit `2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b`.
License: [MIT](LICENSE), preserved verbatim from that commit.
Source SHA-256: `2befe7fc55bcadaa3d97dd9e8efeb633d2561c0ebe74c5a8b17c4d9e7e4520b3`.

Echo rewrites the skill and adds explicit-only Codex metadata. Evidence before
claims remains, with criterion/revision/environment identity and truthful
pass/fail/not-run reporting. Matching prior evidence may be reused instead of
rerunning unchanged checks. Test selection, prepare/verify write boundaries,
full-E2E approval and real-environment authorization follow Echo contracts.
Unconditional reruns, Git operations and upstream sub-skill dependencies are
omitted. No scripts, runtime or additional references are required.

For updates, review the pinned source changes and Echo boundaries, preserve the
license, update the pin/hash and validate the skill, links and role profiles.
